pa:2610.22194.desc: AutoSFT uses multi-agent collaboration to automate diverse supervised fine-tuning data actions, improving evaluation scores over single-agent systems by separating execution, analysis, and synthesis.

pa:2610.22347.name: Speculative Forcing for Efficient Autoregressive Video Generation
pa:2610.22347.desc: Speculative Forcing accelerates few-step autoregressive video generation by accepting early token drafts and skipping unnecessary denoising steps while preserving output quality.

pa:2610.18829.name: OmniCompass: A Holistic Benchmark for Omni-Modal Video Grounding and Understanding
pa:2610.18829.desc: OmniCompass is a holistic benchmark for omni-modal video grounding and understanding that evaluates vision-language and audio-visual reasoning through temporal grounding, spatial grounding, and question answering tasks.
pa:2610.18829.zh: 全面評測多模態影片理解與空間定位能力
pa:2610.18829.why: 建立更全面的評測標準，讓AI能同時看懂畫面、聽懂聲音並精準回答影片內容

pa:2610.18461.name: MFVSR: A Multi-Style and Fine-Grained Benchmark for Video Subtitle Removal
pa:2610.18461.desc: MFVSR introduces a large-scale, multi-style benchmark for video subtitle removal that evaluates restoration fidelity, preservation, temporal consistency, and reliability through fine-grained, spatially decoupled protocols.

pa:2610.17113.name: Calibrated Typed Decisions for Entity, Relation, and Event Extraction
pa:2610.17113.desc: CalOn is a compact unified encoder that jointly performs entity, relation, and event extraction across diverse schemas by encoding text with type definitions and using shared probabilistic reasoning over combined type evidence.

pa:2610.21412.name: JevAgentHarness: Benchmarking, Deploying and Training Decision Models That Share Control with LLMs
pa:2610.21412.desc: A harness that delegates agent tool choices to small decision models via fitted confidence thresholds reduces cost and latency while preserving task success, supported by a new benchmark and a 4B model trained on agent error states.

pa:2610.16105.name: Beyond Policy Rollouts: Embedding-Space Directional Exploration with Anchored Noise for LLM RLVR
pa:2610.16105.desc: EDEN improves reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards by injecting anchored embedding noise into rollout conditioning to increase diversity and strengthen group-relative advantage signals without altering inference.

pa:2610.20993.name: One Bias Score, Two Factors: How Mitigations Affect Option Bias in Multiple-Choice Evaluation
pa:2610.20993.desc: Selection bias and order sensitivity in multiple-choice models are decomposed into flip rate and positional skew via pooled standard deviation, showing that prior correction and aggregation target different factors and should be reported together with accuracy.

pa:2610.22371.name: Gen4P: Video Generators are 4D Perceivers
pa:2610.22371.desc: Gen4P repurposes a pretrained video generator into a feed-forward 4D perceiver that predicts geometry and motion from monocular video via on-demand cross-attention decoding and frozen depth priors.

pa:2610.21500.name: When the KV Cache Is Slower Than the GPU: Scaling Remote KV Tiers for Context-Parallel Prefill
pa:2610.21500.desc: Remote KV caching for long-context LLM serving can severely degrade latency unless the store is sharded by parallel rank, loaded asynchronously, and paired with high-bandwidth retrieval, yielding large throughput gains.

pa:2610.17959.name: Virtual Head Attention
pa:2610.17959.desc: Virtual Head Attention improves long-context model efficiency by reducing KV cache and compute while preserving quality through lightweight linear query and output transformations.

pa:2610.14232.name: Speech event detector: Timestamped detection of non-verbal vocalizations and background sounds for rich speech transcription
pa:2610.14232.desc: A convolutional-Transformer model detects 54 speech and background event classes with timestamped outputs merged into transcripts, trained on unified multi-source annotations with synthetic augmentation.

pa:2610.17901.name: FlashMask-3: Efficient and Expressive Mask-Aware Distributed Attention
pa:2610.17901.desc: FlashMask-3 accelerates long-context attention via a Hopper-optimized sparse-mask kernel and distributed context-parallel extensions that eliminate mask-communication overhead and improve training throughput.

pa:2610.22352.name: SUPRA-TEX: 3D Generation with Super-Aligned Texture
pa:2610.22352.desc: SUPRA-Tex decouples visible-material estimation, surface alignment, and 3D completion to generate relightable 3D materials that preserve reference image details and complete unobserved surfaces.

pa:2610.21095.name: Can World and Action Modeling Benefit Each Other under Unified Causal Training?
pa:2610.21095.desc: OneWM unifies causal training of world and action modeling, showing that learning action-conditioned dynamics improves policies and action learning improves multi-view world prediction.

pa:2610.22350.name: FDE-Gym: The Last Mile of AI Delivery
pa:2610.22350.desc: FDE-Gym evaluates AI agents on realistic customer delivery tasks requiring clarification of ambiguous requirements and discovery of unstated constraints, revealing a substantial performance gap compared to well-specified benchmarks.
pa:2610.22350.zh: 用真實客戶交辦任務來考驗AI代理人的實力

pa:2610.22280.name: LEASH: Uncertainty-Aware Weak-to-Strong Escalation and Oversight for Computer-Use Agents
pa:2610.22280.desc: LEASH is a training-free framework that uses latent uncertainty to escalate from a weak to a strong computer-use agent only when needed and monitors the strong agent afterward, reducing cost while maintaining high success.

pa:2610.15924.name: Scalable Weak-to-Strong Verifier Hardening for Agent Environments
pa:2610.15924.desc: The study proposes an automated weak-to-strong loop that hardens agent environment verifiers against reward hacking by iteratively finding and repairing vulnerabilities in isolated sandboxes.

pa:2610.17697.name: LeanPRM: Lean-Grounded Process Supervision for Natural Language Proof Verification

pa:2610.20461.name: Equal CER, Unequal Damage: Severity-Weighted Character Error Rate for OCR

pa:2610.22358.name: PathFM: Fast Generative Forecasting of Multivariate Trajectories

pa:2610.21025.name: Learning to Read Out: Unembedding Dynamics in Language Model Pretraining
pa:2610.21025.desc: Hidden states encode task information before the readout expresses it, so behavioral timelines reflect readout learning rather than model acquisition, and faster readout training closes this gap earlier.

pa:2610.19247.name: Copy-Paste Language Models
pa:2610.19247.desc: Copy-Paste Language Models enhance in-context copying by adding a lightweight head that improves training efficiency, downstream performance, and long-context retrieval with minimal overhead.

pa:2610.22127.name: Explaining the Roles of Experts in Mixture-of-Experts LLMs for Personalization
pa:2610.22127.desc: Personalizing sparse Mixture-of-Experts language models enables localized, interpretable control over user-specific behaviors through specialized expert routing and learned personalized latents.

pa:2610.09016.name: PAIR: Bridging Perception and Action in Vision-Language-Action Models
pa:2610.09016.desc: PAIR introduces a shared perception-action representation via masked action autoencoders and bridge tokens to improve continuous-action vision-language-action models.

pa:2610.17184.desc: Evaluation has been central to advances in AI, and it is equally critical to autonomous discovery. Yet scaling autonomous discovery to real-world engineering challenges faces a fundamental bottleneck: the cost of evaluating progress. pa:2610.21767.desc: AI agents evaluated on physics research tasks show strong local scientific results but frequently fail to fully resolve research questions due to incomplete evidence and unresolved applicability limits.

pa:2610.22343.name: GeoState: Learning View-Decoupled Geometry States for 3D World Modeling
pa:2610.22343.desc: GeoState introduces a view-independent geometric representation that separates scene dynamics from camera motion for predictive 3D world modeling, enabling consistent multi-view forecasting and cross-dataset generalization.

pa:2610.22471.name: Has GPT-6-Astra Achieved Embodied Intelligence?
pa:2610.22471.desc: GPT-6-Astra achieves high performance across diverse robotic tasks via in-context learning, yet real-world deployment reveals gaps in demonstration cost, execution time, and practical embodied intelligence.
pa:2610.22471.zh: 測試機器人能否像人類一樣靈活思考與行動
pa:2610.22471.why: 探討先進AI模型在真實機器人任務中的表現，指出示範成本與執行時間等實際落差，幫助未來改進

pa:2610.23479.name: HexaShell: A Thin Harness for Exploring the Limits of VLM Agents as Robot Coding Agents
pa:2610.23479.desc: HexaShell is a coding agent that controls a dual-arm robot via vision and self-written tools, achieving state-of-the-art results on RoboDojo but struggling with contact-heavy tasks.
pa:2610.23479.zh: 讓雙臂機器人看懂畫面並自己寫程式來做複雜動作
pa:2610.23479.why: 能靠視覺與寫程式來控制雙臂機器人完成各種高難度任務，比以往更聰明靈活

pa:2610.22234.name: OS-Helix: Unifying GUI Interaction and Code Execution in Native Computer-Using Agents
pa:2610.22234.desc: OS-Helix is an end-to-end trained multimodal agent that integrates GUI actions and code execution via hybrid supervised and reinforcement learning, achieving substantial gains on desktop automation benchmarks.

pa:2610.23787.name: DLite: History-free Speculative Decoding for Agentic AI
pa:2610.23787.desc: DLite improves speculative decoding for agentic AI by eliminating historical context maintenance and using target hidden states for local predictions, boosting acceptance length and reducing overhead.

pa:2610.23841.name: StopWatch: Goal Grounding for Object-goal Navigation
pa:2610.23841.desc: Explicit goal grounding fixes the dominant failure in vision-language navigation policies, yielding near-expert success with minimal policy changes.

pa:2610.23795.name: Persistent Planar Memory for Video World Models
pa:2610.23795.desc: PPMem is a video world model that uses compact plane primitives as persistent 3D memory to generate long coherent videos with explicit metric geometry.

pa:2610.20424.name: BizBench: Unveiling Hidden Challenges in Deploying Long-Horizon Agents for Real-World Business
pa:2610.20424.desc: BizBench evaluates long-horizon business agents on intermediate execution validity using real-world payment procedures, revealing that frontier models frequently violate constraints despite achieving partial goal success.
pa:2610.20424.zh: 測試 AI 處理複雜商業任務的能力，發現常違反規定
pa:2610.20424.why: 用真實支付流程考驗 AI 辦公助理，揪出它們常犯錯的老毛病

pa:2610.18834.name: Game2Real-Bench: Do Toy Games Reveal and Transfer to Real-World Visual Reasoning?
pa:2610.18834.desc: Visual reasoning is an important capability for vision-language models (VLMs) to understand visual evidence, spatial structure, constraints, and state changes. Existing evaluations mainly rely on real-world data or procedurally generated tasks. Real-world data preserve natural complexity, while procedural games provide controllable generation and verifiable solutions. However, it remains unclear w

pa:2610.19159.name: Into the Unknown: Benchmarking AI agents on open scientific research problems
pa:2610.19159.desc: Researchers benchmarked AI agents on open scientific problems by having them draft follow-up papers from unpublished directions, finding that none met expert standards and most contained fabricated claims or contradictory evidence.
pa:2610.19159.zh: 用未公開的科學難題來考 AI 助理，結果全部不及格
pa:2610.19159.why: 測試 AI 寫學術論文的能力，發現它們還是會瞎掰與自相矛盾

pa:2610.23181.name: Tree-Aware Posterior Distillation for Long-Horizon Agentic Reinforcement Learning
pa:2610.23181.desc: TreeOPSD enables long-horizon reinforcement learning for language model agents without critics by using tree-structured self-distillation with bounded updates derived from terminal rewards.

pa:2610.23839.name: DiscoveryRSI: Recursively Learning to Discover Valuable Hypotheses
pa:2610.23839.desc: DiscoveryRSI uses multi-agent evolutionary search and recursive learning to generate testable scientific hypotheses, improving quality through self-improvement and outperforming baseline agents on life-science benchmarks.

pa:2610.18784.name: Pack Light, CarryOn: Building Object-Oriented Context for Long-Horizon Agents
pa:2610.18784.desc: CarryOn organizes long-horizon agent context around reusable task objects rather than interaction histories, improving efficiency and performance on complex benchmarks.

pa:2610.20628.name: PRISM: PRIvileged Sibling-guided Multi-Agent Topology Design
pa:2610.20628.desc: PRISM improves multi-agent topology generators by recovering per-query preferences via privileged sibling-graph information, reducing cross-task drift.

pa:2610.09872.name: LiveMACE: Process-Aware Evaluation of LLM Agent Capabilities in Evolving Markets
pa:2610.09872.desc: LiveMACEBench evaluates persistent LLM agents in live financial markets using decision traces to reveal gaps between outcomes and underlying capabilities.

pa:2610.23121.desc: Generating complete, coherent, and usable 3D indoor scenes from natural language requires strong design intelligence: the ability to design high-quality scenes and critique their quality. In this work, we introduce Scene-Designer, an agentic framework that learn

pa:2610.09221.name: Consistent Distribution Matching for Data-Free Diffusion Distillation
pa:2610.09221.desc: Consistent Distribution Matching accelerates diffusion and flow models via simulation-free, data-free distillation that unifies generation and score estimation, achieving strong one-step and few-step results.

pa:2610.22428.name: Embeddings Are Overpriced? A Frozen 16 MB Vocabulary for Small and Ternary Language Models
pa:2610.22428.desc: Replacing a learned embedding table with a frozen binary code table reduces model size and parameters while maintaining or improving performance on several benchmarks, and enables faster CPU inference with a ternary body.

pa:2610.23230.name: RAP: A Dataset for Paper-to-Poster Generation via Declarative Markup from Human-Crafted Exemplars
pa:2610.23230.desc: RAP introduces a large-scale dataset and benchmark for generating conference posters from papers as a visual coding task, providing verified paper-poster-markup triplets and both retrieval-based and trained generation methods.

pa:2610.18082.name: Failure Recovery via Belief Updates and World Modeling for Long-Horizon Agents
pa:2610.18082.desc: BELIEFWEAVER improves long-horizon agent recovery by combining persistent evidence with prospective reasoning and distilling reasoning into a smaller model.

pa:2610.14022.name: OPMD: On-Policy Mechanism Distillation Beyond Output Supervision
pa:2610.14022.desc: On-Policy Mechanism Distillation improves language model distillation by transferring teacher intermediate computations compatible with the student's architecture, yielding stronger reasoning and internalization.

pa:2610.22169.name: Lexical Reference Frames: Interpreting LM Residual Streams in Native Semantics
pa:2610.22169.desc: Lexical reference frames interpret hidden states through a model's own remaining layers, enabling accurate attribution, steering, and early layer exit.

pa:2610.21783.name: Learning to Think and Explore in 3D World
pa:2610.21783.desc: ACT3D trains vision-language models via reinforcement learning to actively explore 3D environments from single first-person views, improving answer accuracy through adaptive, question-conditioned navigation without direct exploration supervision.

pa:2610.21783.why: 訓練 AI 像人類一樣在陌生空間轉頭探索，回答問題更準確

pa:2610.16071.name: Dream2Discern: Learning from Hard Latent Variants for Runtime Failure Prediction in Multi-Agent Systems
pa:2610.16071.desc: Dream2Discern improves runtime auditing of multi-agent systems by implicitly augmenting training data through self-guided hard example generation, boosting accuracy without new trajectory verification.

pa:2610.23194.name: OfficeTown: Generative Organizations for Evolving Agent Intelligence
pa:2610.23194.desc: OfficeTown is a generative simulation framework that creates persistent professional organizations to generate work-grounded training data and evaluation benchmarks for AI agents.

pa:2610.21082.name: SciΠvot: Benchmarking Principal-Investigator Judgment at Pivotal Moments of Scientific AutoResearch Agents
pa:2610.21082.desc: SciΠvot evaluates LLM agents' scientific judgment using 248 human-corrected cases, revealing that frontier models often prefer flawed plans over expert corrections and perform below human levels.

pa:2610.07898.name: FC-SWE: Failure-Conditioned RL for Long-Horizon Software Engineering Agents
pa:2610.07898.desc: FC-SWE improves reinforcement learning for software engineering agents by conditioning recovery attempts on failed patch feedback, boosting resolution rates across multiple attempts.

pa:2610.20019.name: MorphAct: Robot Policies Morphing with the Worlds They Act In
pa:2610.20019.desc: MorphAct dynamically adapts robot policy parameters via coupled low-rank generators to resolve conflicting updates across interaction contexts, improving vision-language-action performance.

pa:2610.14746.name: BridgeWAM: Bridging Video and Action Experts via Latent Bridge Queries
pa:2610.14746.desc: BridgeWAM decouples video and action experts via latent bridge queries to improve action prediction efficiency and generalization in world action models.

pa:2610.22602.name: Stuck on Shuffle: On Attribute-Object Binding in Vision-Language Models
pa:2610.22602.desc: A new benchmark reveals widespread attribute-object binding failures in multimodal retrievers, and fine-tuning on synthetic text improves cross-modal binding without image supervision.

pa:2610.21046.name: PremiseCheck: Efficient Fact-Checking of Human and AI Peer Reviews
pa:2610.21046.desc: PremiseCheck improves peer review verification by decomposing comments into explicit premises checked by decision models, achieving high accuracy with lower cost and latency.
pa:2610.21046.zh: 把審稿意見拆解成獨立前提來自動驗證，又快又準
pa:2610.21046.why: 幫忙檢查人類與AI的審稿意見，用更低成本達到高準確度

pa:2610.21459.name: Can Visual Generation Expand What Unified Multimodal Models Know?
pa:2610.21459.desc: Visual image-generation training can expand pretrained multimodal models' knowledge, with alignment techniques improving text-based access to that visually acquired information.

pa:2610.05114.name: Belief-Trajectory Energy: Measuring the Path to a Prediction
pa:2610.05114.desc: Belief-Trajectory Energy measures how inputs alter layerwise predictions in language models, yielding signals for task difficulty, review detection, and model attribution.

pa:2610.21073.name: Skip the Compressor: Coding Agents Fix More Issues When They Pick Whole Files
pa:2610.21073.desc: CQ2-CARE improves software issue resolution by selecting exact files to include verbatim within a token budget, outperforming compression and retrieval methods.

pa:2610.22321.name: AVC-Reward: Event-Centric Audio-Video Consistency Evaluation
pa:2610.22321.desc: An event-centric framework evaluates audio-video consistency across complex multi-event scenes by measuring global harmony, temporal synchronization, and attribute alignment via a trainable reward model.

pa:2610.20951.name: LEV: Thinking Fast and Deep with Looped Decision Models
pa:2610.20951.desc: LEV is a looped decision model that increases reasoning depth by iterating its layers without generating tokens, improving accuracy on hard questions while allowing adaptive computation via a stopper.
pa:2610.20951.zh: 不用產生文字就能反覆思考的決策模型
pa:2610.20951.why: 讓AI在遇到難題時能自己多想幾步再回答，不用浪費時間生字，答得更準又省力

pa:2610.21189.name: Resisting Harmful Instructions through Training-Free Weight Editing
pa:2610.21189.desc: A training-free weight-editing method reduces instruction-tuned model compliance with harmful behaviors by applying contrast-based edits to model weights using minimal prompt pairs.

pa:2610.23036.name: Towards Looped Models Done Right, Part I: Topology, Input Injection, Recurrent-State Design
pa:2610.23036.desc: Isolating recurrence design axes reveals that a prelude-recurrent block-coda sandwich architecture improves reasoning and context extraction, with advantages transferring to parameter-efficient Mixture-of-Experts models.

pa:2610.19625.name: DAGFormer: Global Topology Prediction for Transformer Cross-Layer Connections
pa:2610.19625.desc: DAGFormer improves Transformer efficiency by using a jointly trained topology predictor to plan cross-layer connections globally, reducing perplexity and boosting downstream task performance across model scales.

pa:2610.22029.name: Selection Is Not Learning: Choosing Model Futures
pa:2610.22029.desc: EvoHeir improves self-evolving language model loops by separating parameter and experience inheritance and using fresh evaluation to confirm updates, reducing harmful inheritance and boosting reasoning performance.
pa:2610.22029.org: Mohamed Bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence

pa:2610.23374.name: MOSS-Image Technical Report
pa:2610.23374.desc: MOSS-Image is an open diffusion transformer that combines high-fidelity synthesis with intent-aware prompt enhancement to generate text-rich, layout-coherent images, achieving state-of-the-art open-weight results on long-form text and layout benchmarks.

pa:2610.21302.name: Dusting the Phantom: Gaussian Allocation for Fading Dynamic Content
pa:2610.21302.desc: Dynamic Gaussian representations are improved by allocating primitives based on predicted spatiotemporal destinations rather than current locations, recovering small fast-moving objects and fine textures.

pa:2610.23542.name: Execution Before Memory: Diagnosing Memory Failures in Video World Models
pa:2610.23542.desc: MIST separates scene setup from change execution to isolate memory failures in video world models, and M3-Agent improves instruction execution to significantly boost benchmark scores.

pa:2610.20503.name: ReaDy: Recurrent States as Dynamic Context for Speculative Drafting in Hybrid Linear Attention Large Language Models
pa:2610.20503.desc: ReaDy accelerates autoregressive generation by using hybrid linear attention recurrent states to retrieve position-specific context for speculative drafting, improving speed and acceptance rates.

pa:2610.19636.name: Sparse Autoencoders Are a Shared Coordinate System for Symbolic Matching
pa:2610.19636.desc: SAE-IDF matches symbolic units across heterogeneous systems using sparse autoencoders and rarity-weighted features, enabling scalable neuro-symbolic reasoning.

pa:2610.21467.name: DuET: Note-Frame Dual Encoding for Piano Performance-to-Score Transcription
pa:2610.21467.desc: DuET is a dual-encoder transformer that jointly performs MIDI-to-score transcription and beat tracking to improve timing and duration accuracy in piano performance transcription.

pa:2610.14157.name: OpenMobile-2: Building Versatile Mobile Agents with Scalable Environments and App-Native Tools
pa:2610.14157.desc: OpenMobile-2 is an open mobile agent trained with diverse simulated apps, large-scale supervised and reinforcement learning data, and hybrid GUI-tool use, achieving strong benchmark results and real-device transfer.

gh:headroomlabs-ai/headroom.desc: Compress tool outputs, logs, files, and RAG chunks before they reach the LLM.

pa:2610.16763.name: Relational Learning as World Modeling
pa:2610.16763.desc: Relational learning typically predicts from a database state, but decision making asks a different question: how will that state change under an action? In operational systems, the answer depends on system-specific dynamics that may not be visible in the database itself. We view each such system as a relational "world" and ask whether a model can infer how it behaves from observed executions. We i

pa:2610.22697.name: What It Is, Not What It Says: Securing Agentic Browsing Interactions with Web Semantics
pa:2610.22697.desc: Intact protects AI web agents by isolating webpage elements via provenance-aware representations and enforcing capability-bound execution with user consent for third-party actions.

pa:2610.22306.name: ARC-SORT: Adaptive, Robust, Compensated Multi-Object Tracking with Interacting Multiple Models
pa:2610.22306.desc: ARC-SORT improves multi-object tracking in sports broadcasts by using adaptive uncertainty-based search regions, corrective identity swaps, and appearance-only re-identification to achieve high accuracy with minimal identity switches.

pa:2610.21482.name: AI-Driven Disaster Response and Displacement Monitoring
pa:2610.21482.desc: ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE (AI) has demonstrated its potential across a wide range of humanitarian tasks, offering scalable and data-driven solutions to some of the world's most pressing challenges. For instance, in addressing climate change, AI-powered models are being used for faster and more accurate global weather forecasting, control and design of renewable energy, and monitoring deforestation.

pa:2610.23279.name: Xiaomi-Lens-0 Technical Report
pa:2610.23279.desc: Xiaomi-Lens-0 is a 4B multimodal model that predicts masks from internal visual representations to improve fine-grained region reasoning and referring comprehension.

sp:baidu/Unlimited-OCR.zh: 百度開發的無限長度光學字元辨識工具

sp:makiblek/Wan_2.2_I2V_14B_Custom_Lora_.zh: 基於萬物模型的自訂微調影音生成應用

pa:2610.19432.name: Recognition Is Not Grounding: Benchmarking Multilingual Financial Evidence Extraction
pa:2610.19432.desc: The study introduces MULTIFINGROUND, a multilingual benchmark showing that language models recognize financial concepts across languages but frequently fail to recover all corresponding numerical evidence.

pa:2610.07052.name: BRACE: Adapting Whole-Body References for Force and Terrain Aware Humanoid Motion Tracking
pa:2610.07052.desc: BRACE is a whole-body humanoid tracker that integrates commanded hand forces and terrain adaptation by transforming references and distilling teachers into a proprioceptive flow-matching policy.

pa:2610.17644.name: DisaggKD: Efficient Knowledge Distillation through Teacher-Student Disaggregation and a Fused Loss
pa:2610.17644.desc: Knowledge distillation (KD) frameworks place teacher and student on the same GPUs, so per-GPU memory limits the teachers that fit. DisaggKD separates them across nodes: teacher replicas stream hidden states to the student, a KD loss over row windows and vocabulary shards equals the full-vocabulary loss in exact arithmetic without forming the full-vocabulary logits, and a prefetch ring paces produc

pa:2610.22448.name: Lean4AgenticRL: Advancing Agentic RL with Verifiable Multi-level Process Rewards
pa:2610.22448.desc: Lean4AgenticRL integrates multi-level process rewards into a Lean4 formalization framework to improve agentic reinforcement learning for software engineering and terminal tasks, yielding stronger model performance.

pa:2610.16402.name: EvoWeb: A Benchmark for Coding Agents on Evolving Web Applications
pa:2610.16402.desc: Web application development often proceeds through successive requests that extend an existing implementation. Yet web-generation benchmarks primarily evaluate development toward fixed specifications. We introduce EvoWeb, a novel benchmark comprising 320 cumulative requests over 32 web applications, grounded in real-world product features and structured by functional dependency graphs. Agents iter

pa:2610.22744.name: OmniXRef: A Unified Framework for Multimodal Multi-Reference Video Editing
pa:2610.22744.desc: Creative intent in video editing can be expressed through text instructions (e.g., "remove the people"), image references (e.g., subject appearance), video references (e.g., camera movement), or a combination of the above. We introduce OmniXRef, a unified framework for multimodal multi-reference video editing that allows users to combine variable numbers of text, image, and video references to con

pa:2610.22273.name: Librarian Agents: Training LLMs to Curate Long-Context Workspaces that Anticipate Future Queries
pa:2610.22273.desc: Librarian Agents use reinforcement learning to train builder agents that reorganize document corpora into reusable hierarchical workspaces, improving downstream reasoning accuracy and amortizing costs across queries.

pa:2610.22708.name: GlobeBench: Evaluating Text-Based World Model Capabilities for Scalable Environment Simulations
pa:2610.22708.desc: GlobeBench introduces a standardized benchmark of 1,632 tasks across five domains to evaluate text-based world models, revealing that current LLMs struggle with propagating action effects across dependent objects.

sp:observantdistressed/minimax-h3-turbo.name: observantdistressed/minimax-h3-turbo
sp:observantdistressed/minimax-h3-turbo.zh: 提供 MiniMax H3 Turbo 模型的互動介面

pa:2610.26770.name: HarnessPro: Recursive Harness Self-Improvement with Pareto Optimization for Performance-Cost Trade-offs
pa:2610.26770.desc: HarnessPro evolves AI agent harnesses without labels to boost task success and lower execution costs, yielding lightweight, balanced, and high-performance variants via trajectory diagnosis and weighted selection.

pa:2610.20597.name: Co-Evolving Acting and Forecasting for Language Agents
pa:2610.20597.desc: CoPE improves agentic reinforcement learning by training policies to generate multi-step action sequences from trajectory histories, increasing sample efficiency without inference overhead.

pa:2610.21791.name: RSIFlow: Adaptive Self-Improvement Workflows with an Evolving Meta-Agent
pa:2610.21791.desc: RSIFlow is a recursive self-improvement framework that dynamically selects component-specific workflows based on execution feedback and evolves a meta-agent to refine orchestration and skills.

pa:2610.25690.name: ScaleNav: Scalable Internet Video Pretraining for Language-Conditioned Local Navigation
pa:2610.25690.desc: ScaleNav learns goal-directed visual dynamics from internet egocentric videos to generate robot actions for language-conditioned local navigation, achieving high success rates in simulation and real-world deployment.

pa:2610.17816.name: Empowering Edge Agents: A Systematic Analysis of Edge-Cloud Collaboration in LLM Agent Execution
pa:2610.17816.desc: EC2-Bench evaluates edge-cloud collaboration for long-horizon LLM agents, revealing trade-offs among performance, resource use, and privacy, and showing that stronger edge models favor more edge-controlled collaboration.

pa:2610.24087.name: OR-License: Evaluating LLM Agents as Real-World Operations Research Practitioners
pa:2610.24087.desc: OR-License evaluates whether LLM agents can solve real-world operations research problems from original client materials, finding that while some achieve high objective quality, none match expert-level feasibility and deployment-adjusted quality.
pa:2610.24087.zh: 評估 AI 代理人能否解決真實世界的作業研究問題
pa:2610.24087.why: 測試 AI 處理實際營運最佳化任務的能力，發現雖然部分 AI 答案品質不錯，但整體可行性與專家相比仍有明顯差距

pa:2610.26216.name: RoAR-VAE: Improving Latent Diffusability through Robust Prediction
pa:2610.26216.desc: RoAR-VAE improves visual tokenizers by enforcing robust prediction of semantics and reconstruction from corrupted latents, balancing fidelity with diffusion learnability.

pa:2610.23600.name: Learning to Discriminate Scene Structures Makes Self-Supervised Depth Learning Scalable
pa:2610.23600.desc: The MaSS framework improves self-supervised monocular depth estimation across diverse scenes by separating structural representations from contextual features and using a scene-structure discrimination objective, enabling scalable mixed-domain training and strong zero-shot generalization.

pa:2610.25666.name: Frechet Forcing: Training Long-Horizon Streaming World Models from Short Clips
pa:2610.25666.desc: Fréchet Forcing fine-tunes streaming video world models using self-generated rollouts and real-data statistics to prevent long-horizon drift without requiring teachers or long videos.

pa:2610.22791.name: Self-Evolving Coding Agents via Harness-Policy Optimization
pa:2610.22791.desc: Self-HPO is a recursive framework that alternates harness and policy optimization for coding agents, improving performance by targeting evolving failure modes through reinforcement learning.

pa:2610.25296.name: World Model Interpretability: From Decoding Representations to Understanding Latent Worlds
pa:2610.25296.desc: JEPA latent-world interpretability should shift from decoding representations to analyzing how latent variables interact, evolve, and causally drive prediction through grounding, structuring, verifying, and acting.

pa:2610.04902.name: Self-Evaluating Recursive Agents
pa:2610.04902.desc: SERA trains recursive language agents to generate evaluation rubrics for subtasks, improving decomposition, solving, and self-evaluation with reduced external supervision.

pa:2610.25404.name: MT Forcing: Towards Stable and Consistent Multi-Turn Image Editing with Autoregressive Diffusion
pa:2610.25404.desc: MT Forcing improves multi-turn image editing by combining single-turn distribution matching distillation and teacher-forcing guidance to stabilize visual quality and preserve cross-turn consistency.

pa:2610.22732.name: TokenEconomizer: Experience-Driven Black-Box Cost Control for Coding Agents
pa:2610.22732.desc: TokenEconomizer reduces recurring token costs of coding agents across sequential real-world tasks by pruning irrelevant tools, injecting micro-skills, and interrupting failure loops.

pa:2610.19378.name: Robust Explanatory Analysis for Structured Optimization Networks (REASON) in Learning
pa:2610.19378.desc: A two-loop inference framework resolves residual errors via fast and evidence-seeking loops to improve robustness under distribution shift with lower computation.

sp:rdata92/LTX-2.3-10Eros.zh: 基於 LTX 模型的影片生成測試空間，提供社群試用與視覺化操作

pa:2610.14397.name: RealityBench: Simulated Environments to Evaluate a Vision Language Model's Ability to Document Human Physical Work
pa:2610.14397.desc: Researchers benchmark vision-language models on simulated physical work tasks, finding strengths in text-based documentation but weaknesses in measurement reading, spatial reasoning, and acceptability judgment.

pa:2610.26663.name: RoboValue: A Fine-Grained Sim-and-Real Benchmark for Unified Evaluation of Robotic Value Models
pa:2610.26663.desc: RoboValue introduces a benchmark to evaluate robotic value models across task-state understanding, progress tracking, failure recovery, and consistency in both simulated and real-world settings.

pa:2606.31876.name: Harnessing Textual Refusal Directions for Multimodal Safety
pa:2606.31876.desc: MARS enables multimodal safety steering using only text-derived refusal directions, avoiding the need for multimodal safety data.

pa:2610.25060.name: Policy Is Not Capability: Some Safety Benchmarks Measure Which Definition of "Unsafe" You Trained On
pa:2610.25060.desc: Guardrail benchmark scores primarily reflect labeling policy rather than detection ability, with minor parameter changes shifting results across full ranges and training contamination undermining reported safety metrics.

pa:2610.24133.name: A Conditional No-Hair Theorem for Transformers: How Language Models Forget Their Prompt
pa:2610.24133.desc: Autoregressive transformers retain prompt influence via a power-law decay driven by attention dilution and relay mechanisms, with trained models forgetting faster than untrained ones.

pa:2610.26825.name: MemT-1.0: Towards Memory-Native Evolution
pa:2610.26825.desc: MemT-1.0 introduces a memory-native architecture that embeds continuous memory into foundation model computation, improving long-context efficiency and agentic task performance.

pa:2610.25861.name: ActionRoPE: action as coordinates for spatially consistent control in planar-camera game world models
pa:2610.25861.desc: ActionRoPE encodes action-driven camera motion into world-coordinate rotary positions for consistent spatial control, paired with coordinate-conditioned noise scheduling to stabilize observed regions before generating new content.

pa:2610.26848.name: Where is Physical RSI capability from? An Observational Scaling Law of LLM-as-policy
pa:2610.26848.desc: Physical recursive self-improvement in vision-language agents is evaluated via multi-axis metrics, scaling analysis, and workspace interventions to assess improvement speed, limits, and reusable experience.

pa:2610.24791.name: UniAVC: Unified Audio-Video Creation via Progressive Training and Asymmetric Scheduling
pa:2610.24791.desc: UniAVC trains separate audio and video branches on abundant unimodal data before aligning them with scarce paired data, using independent noise schedules and asymmetric supervision to enable joint synthesis, cross-modal generation, and instruction-guided editing.

pa:2610.25011.name: FineSplat: Fine Patches, Local Groups, Detailed Splats
pa:2610.25011.desc: FineSplat improves feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting by using fine-grained patches, dual grouping for efficient multi-view interaction, rendering-based feedback, and compact Gaussian generation to recover richer geometry and appearance efficiently.

pa:2610.24766.name: ECHO: Efficient Causal Self-Recursion Beyond Auxiliary Multi-Token Prediction
pa:2610.24766.desc: ECHO integrates multi-horizon prediction into the backbone via self-recursion and dynamic depth sampling, improving pretraining efficiency and inference drafting without auxiliary modules.

pa:2610.26834.name: Kronecker Delta Rule for Long Context Linear Attention
pa:2610.26834.desc: KronLSTM introduces a Kronecker Delta Rule for stable associative memory updates in linear attention, improving long-context modeling without extra normalization.

pa:2610.23986.name: BlenderWorld: Benchmarking Visual Agents for 3D Creation from Real-World References
pa:2610.23986.desc: BlenderWorld is a benchmark for evaluating multimodal language models on realistic 3D creation tasks using rendered outputs and binary rubrics, revealing significant gaps in spatial coherence.

pa:2610.26824.name: SpecMRL: Redesign Matryoshka Representation Learning within Parametric Spectrum
pa:2610.26824.desc: SpecMRL improves compressed embeddings by reorganizing features via a learned spectral basis that prioritizes informative directions, outperforming standard MRL at reduced dimensions.

pa:2610.26863.name: Text-to-Image Generative Modeling Without Language Pretraining
pa:2610.26863.desc: Halcyon demonstrates that strong text-to-image generation can be achieved by training multimodal autoregressive models from scratch on image-text pairs without relying on large-scale language pretraining.

pa:2610.09496.name: Sparse Feature Policy Unlearning Mitigates State Hallucination in Vision-Language-Action Models
pa:2610.09496.desc: Researchers identify state hallucination in vision-language-action models and propose sparse feature unlearning to reduce failure behaviors while preserving manipulation skills.

pa:2610.16782.name: LIBERO-Industry: Benchmarking Robotic Manipulation under Industrial Process Constraints
pa:2610.16782.desc: LIBERO-Industry introduces a benchmark translating industrial manufacturing constraints into controllable robot learning tasks to evaluate generalist policies under realistic production conditions.
pa:2610.16782.org: Physical AI Group, Institute of AI for Engineering (IAIE), Tongji University

pa:2610.17724.name: Evidence-First Agentic Verification
pa:2610.17724.desc: Sauron is an evidence-first agentic verifier that independently validates claims against environment state and execution traces to improve rubric-based evaluation accuracy and reduce reinforcement-learning reward errors.

pa:2610.06830.name: MemPilot: Orchestrating On-Demand Multimodal Memory Curation for LLM Agents
pa:2610.06830.desc: MemPilot uses reinforcement learning to dynamically curate multimodal agent memory, balancing performance, cost, and latency through adaptive retrieval and model selection.

pa:2610.26765.name: HandsOn: A Large-Scale Simulation Benchmark for Generalizable Dexterous Manipulation
pa:2610.26765.desc: HandsOn is a cross-embodiment simulation benchmark and platform for dexterous manipulation that evaluates generalization across robotic arms, hands, objects, and composed tasks, revealing substantial gaps in current multi-task policies and foundation-model-based control.

pa:2610.25874.name: Vision-Language-Delta-Action: Learning Compact Deltas as Actionable Transition Interfaces for Robotic Manipulation
pa:2610.25874.desc: VLDA reformulates robotic control as compact transition modeling via a Delta variable that bridges vision-language understanding and action generation, improving long-horizon consistency and generalization.

pa:2610.24611.name: HSPR: Recovering Software-Agent Benchmark Scores via Hierarchical Posterior Inference
pa:2610.24611.desc: Hierarchical Score Posterior Recovery improves agent evaluation efficiency by combining historical response patterns with adaptive task selection to estimate full benchmark scores from small subsets.

pa:2610.25950.name: AdaExploreBench: Benchmarking LLM Agents for Proactive Exploration and Test-time Adaptation in Evolving Environments
pa:2610.25950.desc: AdaExploreBench evaluates whether LLM agents can actively discover hidden environmental rules and adapt to unannounced changes, revealing that current models struggle to seek relevant evidence and detect stale knowledge.

pa:2609.22332.name: AffordanceWAM: Affordance-Aware Joint World-Action Modeling for Robot Manipulation
pa:2609.22332.desc: AffordanceWAM uses affordance representations from human videos to jointly predict future scenes and robot actions, improving manipulation transfer without human action labels.

pa:2610.26802.name: Scaling Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning for Brain Encoding
pa:2610.26802.desc: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning with low-rank adapters enables efficient adaptation of very large multimodal backbones for brain encoding, improving performance and interpretability while reducing computational cost.
pa:2610.26802.zh: 用聰明的方法微調超大型多模態模型來解讀大腦訊號
pa:2610.26802.why: 降低運算成本並提升準確度，讓AI更好地理解人類大腦活動

pa:2610.26549.name: Holi-World: Building Holistic World Intelligence from Human-Ego Experience
pa:2610.26549.desc: HOLI-WORLD is an integrated ecosystem that automates the construction of large-scale learning resources from egocentric recordings to improve machine understanding of dynamic scenes and interactions.

pa:2610.25736.name: Learning from Fleet Experience: A Collective Learning Paradigm for Robots
pa:2610.25736.desc: Robots share execution experience across fleets to improve policies via failure-guided retrieval and asynchronous training, achieving high success without extra expert corrections.

pa:2610.26830.name: Competing Learning in Hybrid Architectures
pa:2610.26830.desc: Hybrid language models suffer from competing learning between recurrence and attention layers, and a staged training procedure improves retrieval and overall performance.

pa:2610.26853.name: InfiniDream: Open-Ended Photorealistic 3D Worlds Through Procedural Generation
pa:2610.26853.desc: InfiniDream is a vision-language model framework that generates open-ended, editable, photorealistic 3D worlds through symbolic procedural asset creation and deterministic scene placement.

pa:2610.26811.name: State World Models: Execute the Rules, Generate the Pixels
pa:2610.26811.desc: A framework called Stateful Harness separates rule-based world state updates from frozen video rendering to improve consistency in interactive world models with hidden state, evaluated via the WorldState-Bench benchmark.

pa:2610.26851.name: Manga2Animate: An Agentic Framework for Faithful Manga Animation with Script and Storyboard Planning
pa:2610.26851.desc: Manga2Animate uses paired creator and reviewer agents to build script and storyboard representations from manga panels, yielding more faithful and consistent animations.
pa:2610.26851.org: National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University

pa:2610.23935.name: Factorization-Guided Training and Inference for Diffusion-Drafted Speculative Decoding
pa:2610.23935.desc: DScout improves speculative decoding throughput by aligning diffusion drafter training and inference with prefix acceptance and latency trade-offs.

pa:2610.26860.name: OpenVLHarness: Real World Visual Agentic Tool-Use with Multimodal Memory
pa:2610.26860.desc: OpenVLHarness improves multimodal reasoning by integrating persistent memory, heterogeneous tool interfaces, and iterative evidence composition across 22 benchmarks.

pa:2610.19686.name: Interlock: From Local Correctness to Task Completion in Long-Horizon Agents
pa:2610.19686.desc: Interlock synthesizes long-horizon tasks as typed completion graphs to enforce cross-component constraints, then uses agent-based verification and self-training to improve agent performance on complex benchmarks.

pa:2610.24960.name: CoworkEnv: Synthesizing Training Environments for Long-Horizon Cowork Agents
pa:2610.24960.desc: CoworkEnv synthesizes executable training environments for AI coworkers using workflow-guided task construction and programmatic validation, enabling supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning of compact PocketWorker models that improve multi-turn coordination and tool use.

pa:2610.26625.name: EgoXperience: Learning World-Grounded Egocentric Representations from Human Experience
pa:2610.26625.desc: EgoXperience introduces a unified framework for joint reconstruction of camera motion, scene geometry, hands, and objects from egocentric video using automatically annotated large-scale data and a single-pass model.

pa:2610.26453.name: Remembering Has a Price: Learning Memory Worth under Resource Constraints
pa:2610.26453.desc: TokenWorth is a lightweight online memory framework that learns which past experiences are worth retaining and reusing under tight resource constraints, improving lifelong agent success while reducing token usage.

pa:2610.26844.name: AnyGoal: On World Model Generalization Beyond Expert Rollouts
pa:2610.26844.desc: Researchers introduce AnyGoal to evaluate whether world models can generalize dynamics to unseen combinations of familiar states and actions for planning.

pa:2610.23470.name: QD-Rec: Open-Ended Evolution of Recommendations via Quality-Diversity
pa:2610.23470.desc: QD-Rec uses quality-diversity optimization and foundation models to generate diverse, well-reasoned recommendations for high-stakes decision-making.

pa:2610.25265.name: SPARC: Spoken Profile Authorship Recognition Corpus
pa:2610.25265.desc: Transcribed speech retains speaker and demographic information that large language models can exploit for verification, though releasing only brief text excerpts reduces linkage risk.

pa:2610.25090.name: Think Visually Across Space and Time: Grounded Reasoning for Video Segmentation
pa:2610.25090.desc: TCoVP introduces a spatiotemporally grounded video reasoning chain that links entities to timestamped visual evidence for segmentation, improving reasoning and mask prediction across benchmarks.

pa:2610.26081.name: DeOverlay: A Benchmark and Source-Anchored Flow for Video Overlay Removal
pa:2610.26081.desc: DeOverlay uses source-anchored flow matching and visibility-normalized temporal aggregation to remove video overlays while preserving scene structure, and introduces DVTE-Bench for standardized evaluation.

pa:2610.19439.name: Progress-Aware Distillation for Mitigating Stagnation in Small Language Model Agents
pa:2610.19439.desc: Progress-Aware Distillation detects and penalizes stagnation in distilled small language model agents to improve reasoning efficiency and success rates.

pa:2610.06563.name: HERA: Harness-Environment Co-Evolution for Reliable Agentic Abstention
pa:2610.06563.desc: HERA co-evolves agent harnesses and task environments to improve abstention and task completion across diverse LLMs without model-specific tuning.

pa:2610.22324.name: Training Reasoning Models to Generate Diverse Scientific Ideas
pa:2610.22324.desc: Researchers propose a set-level reinforcement learning objective to train language models for diverse, high-quality, document-grounded idea generation, achieving stronger creative utility than larger proprietary models.

pa:2610.22328.name: ACEdit: Stable Multi-Turn Image Editing via Asymmetric Conditioning
pa:2610.22328.desc: Self-forcing training with teacher distillation and asymmetric conditioning stabilizes multi-turn image editing against accumulating distribution shifts.

pa:2610.19005.name: CyberArena: Benchmarking AI Agents in Live Symmetric Attack-and-Defense Combat
pa:2610.19005.desc: CyberArena is a dynamic adversarial benchmark that evaluates AI agents through concurrent multi-round attack-and-defense combat in evolving environments, measuring capabilities via a dynamical scoring model.

pa:2610.21810.name: N-Gram Memories at Two Bits: Quantizing Lookup Tables in Large Language Models
pa:2610.21810.desc: Conditional Program compresses language-model embedding tables by reconstructing only requested rows via shared codes and local scales, reducing storage by 75% while improving fidelity.

pa:2610.19264.name: Beyond Maliciousness: Static and Runtime Attack-Surface Profiling of Agent Skills
pa:2610.19264.desc: Agent skills are Markdown documents that a tool-using agent reads as instructions and then acts on with the privileges of the session that loaded them. Installing one grants authority (the standing to direct the agent, not new privilege), and the size of that grant is what we measure. We present a two-phase attack-surface profiling methodology that combines whole-bundle static analysis and depende

pa:2610.25964.name: Token-Set Choice Confounds POPE: A Systematic Audit of Yes/No Extraction in VLM Hallucination Evaluation
pa:2610.25964.desc: Evaluation readout choices for vision-language models on the POPE benchmark cause large F1 shifts, revealing that unreported token lookup protocols and quantization confound reported hallucination-mitigation gains.

pa:2610.22466.name: Harness-Delta Attribution: Dissecting Gains From Harness Evolution
pa:2610.22466.desc: Harness-Delta Attribution dissects harness evolution gains into overfitting, test-time scaling, and residual generalizable improvement, finding that most search-set gains do not reliably transfer to held-out tasks.

pa:2610.25288.name: Vision as Proprioception: Estimating Humanoid Robot Pose from Video
pa:2610.25288.desc: HumanoidPose recovers full-body humanoid robot joint configurations from video by combining human-pose features with robot kinematics and self-training on unlabeled videos.

pa:2610.23653.name: A Language-Informed Loss for Visual Generation
pa:2610.23653.desc: LILIE uses an invertible normalizing-flow encoder to derive language-informed supervision for text-to-image generation, improving fidelity over pixel-only training.

pa:2610.22714.name: First Passage Attention
pa:2610.22714.desc: First Passage Attention replaces monotonic decay accumulation with path extrema to selectively retain older context, enabling perfect long-range retrieval with compressed caches.

pa:2610.22894.name: Competence-Based Evaluation of Logical Reasoning in Large Language Models
pa:2610.22894.desc: Competence-based evaluation reveals that large language models fail to consistently apply reasoning rules across varied problem presentations despite high accuracy on bounded tasks.

pa:2610.25159.name: Legal Guidance in the Wild: How Users Seek Legal Help in Real-World LLM Conversations
pa:2610.25159.desc: The study develops a taxonomy to identify legal guidance requests in conversational AI, annotates thousands of chats, and evaluates ModernBERT models against a baseline for detecting such queries.

pa:2610.22512.name: Predicting Privileged Information Effectiveness for On-Policy Self-Distillation
pa:2610.22512.desc: On-policy self-distillation with privileged information improves multi-turn agent performance depending on content and source, and KL-based metrics better predict training gains than direct utility estimates.

pa:2610.22636.name: Measuring Mechanistic Uncertainty in Large Language Models via Causal Robustness
pa:2610.22636.desc: Mechanistic uncertainty is quantified via internal mechanism stability using causal robustness margins and concept steering vectors, revealing that incorrect responses are more sensitive to interventions and that learned facts gain robustness.

pa:2610.25525.name: StopLoss: Teaching Agents to Predict Failure and Stop Early
pa:2610.25525.desc: StopLoss is a lightweight external monitor that predicts coding-agent failures from recent tool steps to abort doomed runs early, reducing compute costs while preserving successful outcomes.

pa:2610.16078.name: Heterogeneous Agentic Coevolution
pa:2610.16078.desc: HACE is a framework that jointly evolves specialized foundation models and LLM agents through reciprocal learning and evolutionary optimization of their interaction harness, improving performance across recommendation, protein prediction, and materials discovery.

pa:2604.11331.name: Any 3D Scene is Worth 1K Tokens: 3D-Grounded Representation for Scene Generation at Scale
pa:2604.11331.desc: Direct diffusion modeling in a 3D latent space improves spatial consistency and efficiency for scene-level 3D generation compared to 2D-based methods.

gh:wshobson/agents.desc: Sponsor  Multi-harness agentic plugin marketplace for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCo

pa:2610.28594.name: Learning the 4D World through Point Trajectory Forecasting
pa:2610.28594.desc: Video-Point Model predicts future multi-view videos and 3D point trajectories from video histories and instructions, improving forecasting and robot control through shared 3D-aware representations.

pa:2610.28354.name: S-Agent 2.0: Spatial Reasoning with a General Coding Agent
pa:2610.28354.desc: S-Agent 2.0 improves spatial reasoning by integrating a persistent scene memory and plain-language interpretation into a coding agent with 3D perception tools.

pa:2610.27628.name: PAR: Progress-Aligned Recurrence for Length Generalization in State Tracking
pa:2610.27628.desc: Progress-Aligned Recurrence trains looped language models to match intermediate states and stabilize recurrent norms, enabling strong length extrapolation on sequential tracking tasks.

pa:2610.19419.name: WinARDet: Compressed Window Auto-Regression for Long-Horizon Vision-Language Grounding
pa:2610.19419.desc: Compressed Window Auto-Regression partitions long answer sequences into windows with restricted autoregression and compressed latent history to prevent attention takeover and box repetition in dense vision-language grounding.

pa:2610.28444.name: EvaOmni: An Evidence-Grounded Benchmark for Audio-Visual Reasoning
pa:2610.28444.desc: EvaOmni is an evidence-grounded benchmark that evaluates whether omnimodal language models identify audio-visual evidence and construct reasoning chains for audiovisual questions.

pa:2610.26855.name: Ropedia W0: Scaling Loco-Manipulation World Models across Embodiments with Human Experience
pa:2610.26855.desc: Ropedia W0 is a world foundation model for cross-embodiment loco-manipulation that unifies human and robot data via kinematic representations and achieves state-of-the-art results across diverse benchmarks.

pa:2610.28559.name: Large Flow Language Models
pa:2610.28559.desc: A large-scale continuous flow language model achieves efficient training, high-quality generation, and faster inference through blockwise flow design, self-speculative decoding, and multi-token prediction.

pa:2610.27999.name: Matrix-Game 4.0: Harnessing Video Models for Real-Time Playable Game Worlds
pa:2610.27999.desc: Matrix-Game 4.0 separates game logic from visual synthesis via an executable engine and autoregressive video renderer, achieving real-time interactive gameplay with low latency.

pa:2610.14136.name: Correction Training for Diffusion Models
pa:2610.14136.desc: A correction module trained to refine diffusion predictions reduces exposure bias, improving unguided sample quality and enabling distillation to eliminate inference overhead.

pa:2610.25844.name: SWIFT: Self-guided Weak-to-strong dIFfusion models via Target extrapolation
pa:2610.25844.desc: Swift improves diffusion model training by extrapolating regression targets away from a frozen weak denoiser, reducing error and training cost without inference overhead.

pa:2610.26681.name: From Short Clips to Real-Time Streams: Identity-Aware Supervision and Context-Efficient Generation for Video Face Swapping
pa:2610.26681.desc: StreamingSwap is a real-time flow-matching framework for video face swapping that improves identity fidelity and efficiency via joint identity-reconstruction loss and reduced spatial-temporal generation, achieving stable 20 FPS performance on long videos.

pa:2610.25043.name: VLA-Rolling: Fewer Denoising Steps, Better Control via Adaptive Action Reuse
pa:2610.25043.desc: VLA-Rolling improves vision-language-action model efficiency by reusing discarded action tails with adaptive denoising budgets, reducing inference cost and boosting success rates.

pa:2610.24648.name: EdgeKernelBench: Unified LLM-Driven Kernel Generation for Edge Backends
pa:2610.24648.desc: EdgeKernelBench and LEKA enable unified evaluation and layered optimization of LLM-generated kernels across heterogeneous edge backends, revealing a gap between correctness and performance.

pa:2610.24899.name: HybridResearcher: Bridging the Structured-Unstructured Boundary for Deep Research Agents
pa:2610.24899.desc: HybridResearcher is a small agent trained via synthetic cross-source trajectories and reinforcement learning to reason across structured and unstructured data, outperforming much larger models without forgetting single-source skills.

pa:2610.24452.name: HumanSkill-4D: Training-Free Language Querying of Animatable Gaussian Avatars in Space and Time
pa:2610.24452.desc: HumanSkill-4D enables language-driven selection of avatar regions and motion intervals via shared multimodal reasoning and geometric operators without training.
pa:2610.24452.org: Ulsan National Institute of Science and Technology

pa:2610.28578.name: Sage-A1.5: From Long-Horizon Execution to Scientific Exploration with Capability Composition
pa:2610.28578.desc: Sage-A1.5 is a 35B mixture-of-experts agentic model that improves long-horizon problem solving via adaptive task delegation, verification, and open scientific exploration.

pa:2610.28630.name: SolarRenderer: Few-Step Generative Reference Rendering
pa:2610.28630.desc: SolarRenderer adapts a frozen video backbone with lightweight LoRAs to render realistic videos from diverse structural inputs in four steps or real-time streaming, using frame-aligned training data.

pa:2610.26203.name: Focused Omni-Modal GUI Agents
pa:2610.26203.desc: FocusGUI is a lightweight adapter that dynamically selects relevant multimodal evidence for GUI agents to prevent compounding errors from irrelevant context, improving action accuracy without fine-tuning the backbone.

pa:2610.26067.name: PhysSkin++: Real-Time and Generalizable Physics-Based Animation via Self-Supervised Neural Skinning
pa:2610.26067.desc: PhysSkin++ learns continuous neural skinning fields from static shapes to enable real-time, physics-based animation across diverse geometries and spatial representations without per-object training.

pa:2610.27334.name: EMBER: Predicting TCR--pMHC Binding Without a Docked Complex
pa:2610.27334.desc: EMBER predicts TCR-pMHC binding from independently folded monomers using SE(3)-invariant graphs, avoiding docking errors and reducing computation while improving accuracy across folding tools.

pa:2610.27911.name: MMEnterprise-Bench: Evaluating Enterprise Agents over Evolving Multimodal Records
pa:2610.27911.desc: MMEnterprise-Bench evaluates multimodal agents on reasoning over evolving workplace records with conflicts and missing evidence.

pa:2610.25765.name: TRACE: Tracking Multimodal Clinical Trajectories for Inpatient Risk Prediction
pa:2610.25765.desc: TRACE organizes daily clinical events into temporal trajectories to improve inpatient risk prediction across mortality, length of stay, and readmission tasks.

pa:2610.26754.name: TokenGate: Adapting LLMs for Fast and Memory-Efficient Prefill with Learned Token Pruning
pa:2610.26754.desc: TokenGate is a lightweight learnable token-pruning module that accelerates long-context prefill in transformers by selectively skipping unimportant tokens via token-gated attention.

pa:2610.26711.name: PVBench: Quantifying Physical Plausibility in Video Generation with Object-Level Physical Measurements
pa:2610.26711.desc: PVBench introduces a quantitative benchmark with 46 physical dimensions to evaluate the plausibility of generated videos using specialized vision models and human-aligned metrics.

pa:2609.34565.name: FlowState: Execution State as Memory for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
pa:2609.34565.desc: FlowState improves long-horizon agent performance by maintaining structured, revisitable execution memory with incremental updates and progressive access, reducing token use while increasing success rates.

pa:2610.19425.name: Evaluating Agentic Capabilities Before Post-Training: An End-to-End Approach
pa:2610.19425.desc: ASAP is a lightweight framework that evaluates agentic behavior in pretrained base models via interactive end-to-end tasks without converting them to chat agents.

pa:2610.18604.name: LLM2R: From Large Language Models to 3D Reassemblers
pa:2610.18604.desc: LLM2R treats 3D part assembly as sequence modeling with a pretrained decoder-only LLM, using geometric tokens and learnable summary tokens to predict all part poses in a single pass with improved scalability and accuracy.

pa:2610.27327.name: Unsupervised Tool Evolution for Coding Agents in Data-Lake Analytics
pa:2610.27327.desc: TEAL evolves reusable data-analysis tools for coding agents without ground-truth labels by combining data-driven exploration and trajectory-based critique, improving accuracy under tight step budgets.

pa:2610.22444.name: Event-STVG: Spatio-Temporal Video Grounding for Long-Form Event Reasoning
pa:2610.22444.desc: Event-STVG introduces a challenging benchmark requiring multimodal models to perform long-form event reasoning, repeated-event disambiguation, and multi-target spatio-temporal grounding across extended video contexts.

pa:2610.24628.name: Muse Glimmer 30B: An On-Device Agentic Model
pa:2610.24628.desc: Muse Glimmer is a 30B-parameter open-source causal language model with a perception encoder that performs multi-step reasoning and tool use locally on consumer hardware via 4-bit quantization.

pa:2610.28632.name: Joints, Camera, Action! Co-Generating 3D Motion and Video for Arbitrary Rigs
pa:2610.28632.desc: The model co-generates video and 3D motion for arbitrary skeletons via cross-attention with a pretrained video generator, enabling scene-registered animation and bidirectional video-motion conversion.

pa:2610.27360.name: On the Limits of Scale: Inverse Scaling in Vision-Language Models
pa:2610.27360.desc: Vision-language models show inverse scaling on specific subtasks, where larger versions underperform smaller ones in areas like spatial reasoning and STEM questions, indicating that model choice should be task-specific.

pa:2610.26837.name: SpecKCast: Spectral Kalman Forecasting for Diffusion Acceleration
pa:2610.26837.desc: SpecKCast forecasts diffusion transformer outputs in the frequency domain using per-band Kalman filters and adaptive step scheduling to accelerate inference with minimal memory overhead.

pa:2610.24944.name: Epi: Towards a Persistent, Self-Improving Agent for Autonomous Research
pa:2610.24944.desc: Épi is an autonomous research agent that maintains persistent investigations across sessions, improves through accumulated experience, and achieves record-setting mathematical and algorithmic results with reduced computational cost.

pa:2610.09513.name: OmniCam: Omni-Camera Trajectory Generation via Geometry-Grounded Pose Token Learning
pa:2610.09513.desc: OmniCam is an autoregressive model that generates camera pose sequences from panoramas and text, using geometric and target-aware conditioning to improve trajectory accuracy and reduce collisions.

pa:2610.18950.name: λ_0: Scaling Open-World Egocentric Human Data for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
pa:2610.18950.desc: HumanVerse pairs egocentric video with synchronized body and hand motion to train a humanoid foundation model for whole-body loco-manipulation via human-to-robot transfer without target-task robot demonstrations.

pa:2610.28601.name: Evolving Agent Interfaces
pa:2610.28601.desc: Agent S4 autonomously evolves computer-use interfaces from task experience, significantly improving open-source agent performance and reducing costs compared to larger proprietary models.

pa:2511.14102.name: Specter: Fast MoE Inference via Quantization-Enabled Multi-Step Speculative Offloading
pa:2511.14102.desc: Specter accelerates single-GPU mixture-of-experts inference by combining quantized speculative decoding with expert offloading to hide PCIe latency and improve throughput.

pa:2610.28435.name: Multimodal Reranking Is a System One Decision
pa:2610.28435.desc: A general vision-language model can serve as a multimodal reranker via single-pass choice questions, matching or exceeding dedicated rerankers with minimal tuning.

pa:2610.25369.name: Painting Change Map as guidance for generating painting processes
pa:2610.25369.desc: This work introduces a spatio-temporal Painting Change Map to control video generation of artwork by tracking localized structural changes across time, enabling fine-grained guidance for painting and unpainting processes.

pa:2610.25078.name: CoEvo-RSI: When Harnesses Evolve, Which Models Should Follow?
pa:2610.25078.desc: CoEvo-RSI reduces brain-body mismatch in recursive self-improving agents by using bidirectional historical inheritance to align model capabilities with evolving harness requirements, achieving strong results via supervised fine-tuning.

pa:2610.24649.name: Good Judgment, Bad Advice: Decision-Model Controllers Raise Agent Cost Without Improving Success
pa:2610.24649.desc: A typed decision model consulted at fixed points increased agent costs without improving success rates, despite better ranking of finish requests, due to poor calibration.

pa:2610.26426.name: HarnessRL: Co-Evolving Policies with a Just-in-Time Training Harness for Open-Ended RL
pa:2610.26426.desc: HarnessRL co-evolves a training harness with the policy via adaptive task sampling, rollout guidance, and rubric updates to prevent reward failure in open-ended reinforcement learning.

pa:2610.27406.name: More Memory, Worse Agents: Error Reproduction and Anti-Persistence in LLM Agents
pa:2610.27406.desc: Anti-Persistence improves LLM agent self-improvement by accumulating execution experience while discarding synthesized guidance after use, reducing error reproduction and cost.

pa:2610.27435.name: Harness Self-Evolution for Long-Horizon Terminal Agents
pa:2610.27435.desc: RiseHarness iteratively improves agent harness reliability by analyzing execution traces and integrating mechanisms from other frameworks without altering model weights.

pa:2610.28522.name: DecisionPivot: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Decision Models in LLM Systems
pa:2610.28522.desc: DecisionPivot is a diagnostic benchmark that evaluates decision models across controlled variations, revealing gaps between aggregate accuracy, contrast-group performance, calibration, and reasoning effort.

pa:2606.31002.name: Beyond Compilation: Evaluating Faithful Natural-Language-to-Lean Statement Formalization
pa:2606.31002.desc: The study evaluates whether Lean compilation alone ensures faithful statement autoformalization, finding substantial gaps between compiling and semantically accepted outputs across multiple systems, with tool-augmented agents improving compilation but still exhibiting real translation errors.

pa:2610.26542.name: Breaking Diffusion: Parallel Reasoning with Draft Refinement
pa:2610.26542.desc: DRLMs refine draft answers via parallel token revisions and a single-pass cavity energy evaluation, outperforming autoregressive and diffusion baselines on reasoning tasks.

pa:2610.23400.name: On the Tip of the Tongue: First-Token Cueing as a Behavioral Probe of Recall Failures in LLMs
pa:2610.23400.desc: Many factual errors in large language models stem from failing to generate the correct first token of an answer, and providing that token allows the model to complete and recognize the correct response.

pa:2610.28388.name: Self-Credit: Credit Assignment for Long-Horizon Agentic RL via Intra-group Rescaling
pa:2610.28388.desc: LLM agents are commonly trained with RLVR, but the sparse nature of typical RLVR rewards makes credit assignment challenging, especially for long-horizon tasks. We propose Self-Credit, an end-to-end agentic RL method that creates dense supervision signals from sparse outcome rewards using self-generated credit assignment via intra-group rescaling. pa:2610.16523.name: EAU: Environment-Agent-User Co-evolution for Training User-Centric Agents
pa:2610.16523.desc: EAU is a meta-agent framework that co-evolves the user simulator, environment, and reinforcement learning setup alongside the policy to improve multi-turn LLM agent training.

pa:2610.28074.name: Slot-JEPA: Object-Structured Prediction Interfaces for Latent World Models
pa:2610.28074.desc: Slot-JEPA decomposes dense representations into reusable semantic slots and spatial masks to improve predictive modeling, planning, and transfer across visual tasks.

pa:2610.26857.name: VideoMaMa++: Temporally Consistent Video Matting via Preserve-and-Refine Token
pa:2610.26857.desc: A diffusion-based video matting framework uses separate token streams and learnable embeddings to propagate mattes across chunks, improving temporal consistency and detail accuracy on long videos.

pa:2610.28284.name: HRoPE: Homography Relative Positional Encoding
pa:2610.28284.desc: HRoPE introduces surface-aware positional encoding using slanted 3D planes and homographies to improve cross-view alignment and novel view synthesis without requiring ground-truth geometry.

pa:2610.28554.name: OverSeer: Multi-Agent World Models Beyond What Agents See
pa:2610.28554.desc: OverSeer improves multi-agent world models by adding fixed auxiliary camera views that stabilize consistency and are compressed via delta-VAE to reduce computation.

pa:2610.27190.name: On the Fragility of Tasks under Composition: Implicit Budgeting in Language Models
pa:2610.27190.desc: Modern language models are increasingly asked to handle several tasks within a single prompt. Doing so requires solving each task correctly while integrating the resulting answers into a coherent response. In this paper, we identify a fundamental limitation in this process, where models make substantially more errors when tasks are composed, even when they can solve every constituent task reliably

pa:2610.07609.name: PhysLDM: Latent Diffusion for High-Fidelity Deformable Simulation
pa:2610.07609.desc: PhysLDM introduces a spatiotemporal latent diffusion framework for high-fidelity deformable body simulation, using a holistic VAE and diffusion to model chaotic dynamics and enable zero-shot generalization.
